content: If parameter Controller of CanIf_TTGlobalTimePre- set() has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. CANIF_DEV_ERROR_DETECT equals ON ), the function CanIf_TTGlobalTimePre- set() shall report development error code CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROLLER to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.
